From barren land to a green haven

Our founder, Deepak Vaswani, turned a barren plot into a green haven. Today it's home to orchards of banana, mango, chikoo, guava, lemon, sweet lime, phalsa, tamarind, amla, custard apple, jamun, water apple, rayan, Barbados cherry, litchi, mulberry, jackfruit, fig and palms.

At its heart lies a serene, circular spiritual garden, where Rudraksha, Ashopalav, Bael, Banyan and Peepal trees stand together in harmony.

With farm ponds, two shade-net houses, native trees, and birds returning every season, the land has come alive again.

He named it Amma's Farm.

How we grow happiness

We don't just sell vegetables. We sell our happiness, in the form of food. Here's what goes into every basket.

  1. 1
    Living soilCertified organic by GOPCA, with no chemical fertilisers or pesticides. Our own compost, vermicompost and beneficial microbes feed the soil.
  2. 2
    Mantras in the fieldsSpeakers across the farm play mantras through the day, so the crops grow in calm.
  3. 3
    Picked to orderWe harvest only what's been ordered, the evening before it reaches you.
  4. 4
    Happiness, deliveredWhat arrives in your kitchen is the care of the whole farm. Come and see it grow.

About Amma's Farm

Our founder, Deepak Vaswani, turned a barren plot at Sedfa village, near Kadi, into a green haven. Today it's home to vegetables, exotic greens and orchards of banana, mango, chikoo, guava, lemon, sweet lime, phalsa, tamarind, amla, custard apple, jamun, water apple, rayan, Barbados cherry, litchi, mulberry, jackfruit, fig and palms, with a circular spiritual garden at its heart.

How ordering works

  1. Fill your basketOrder before 8 pm for delivery the next day.
  2. Send it on WhatsAppYour order opens as a ready-made WhatsApp message. We reply to confirm.
  3. Receive and payWe harvest that evening and deliver in your chosen slot. Pay by cash or UPI at the door.
